stage: Exploratory originality audit; fixed before the new negative-control fits
question: Is the re-pairing phenomenon unique to AI data, or an expected property of fitting panel models to differently grouped choices?
population: The300 human-recruitment records only; the60 AI pretests do not enter these fits
conditions: human training answers independently re-paired within version and task
human training answers rank-aligned by alternative within version and task
target: Unchanged original held-out human vectors in the existing five folds
rank_alignment_role: Deliberately constructed dependence stress control, not observed behavior or a proposed data repair
checks: higher-node quadrature check for representative fitted random-intercept parameters
interpretation: A large generic response to re-grouping cannot establish AI-specific originality. A small random-human effect does not prove AI specificity; the source groups have different margins and constructions. No permutation p-value or independent-human replication claim.
stopping_rule: Retain every fixed control and fit. Assess the incremental contribution against primary literature; do not label standard panel likelihood behavior a new theory.
